note: Post-hoc revision; decisions frozen before any revised forecast was scored.

amendments.change: Supplementary calibration series core_ols minus historical_mean for the return task, reported beside the declared series.
amendments.reason: After the first revised scoring run, the declared return series (boost_full minus historical_mean) was identically zero for MTRN and ENTG and nonzero in only 18% of months for CRS and ATI, because validation selected the intercept-only candidate. Demeaning such a sparse series creates near-constant synthetic samples, so its empirical size says little about the test on dense differentials.
amendments.effect_on_rules: None. The declared series and the declared descriptive-only rule are unchanged and still govern; the supplementary series is descriptive context.

amendments.change: Family status: identical_by_exclusion is checked before identical_by_selection, and the retained-set identity is taken before selection.
amendments.reason: Implementation correction found on inspection: an intercept-only fit recorded an empty retained set, so a contrast whose distinguishing predictor failed the coverage gate (ATI P/E) was labelled identical_by_selection. The specification already states that exclusion makes a contrast untestable.
amendments.effect_on_rules: Labels only; no loss, interval or p-value changes.
